PRIVACY.title: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY.intro: Your trust matters to us. This Policy explains how we handle your personal information when you use CriptoJackpot and participate in our promotions.
PRIVACY.contactNote: To exercise your rights or resolve privacy questions, write to us at support@criptojackpot.com.

blocks.heading: Introduction
paragraphs: At CriptoJackpot ("the Platform", "we") we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy describes what information we collect, how we use it, and what your rights are.
By using the Platform you accept the practices described in this Policy. If you do not agree, we ask that you not use the service.

blocks.heading: Information We Collect
bullets: Registration data: first name, last name, email, and password.
Identification and contact data: ID document, phone, country, state, city, and address, when necessary for participation or verification.
Transaction data: history of entries, payments, and cryptocurrency addresses used.
Technical data: IP address, device type, browser, usage data, and cookies.

blocks.heading: How We Use Your Information
bullets: Create and manage your account and enable your participation in the promotions.
Process payments, validate entries, and manage prize delivery.
Verify your identity and age, and prevent fraud and misuse.
Comply with applicable legal, tax, and regulatory obligations.
Improve the Platform, its security, and the user experience.
Send you operational communications and, if you consent, promotional communications.

blocks.heading: Legal Basis for Processing
paragraphs: We process your data on the basis of the performance of the contract (the provision of the service), compliance with legal obligations, our legitimate interest in preventing fraud and improving the service, and your consent where required.

blocks.heading: How We Share Information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information only with:
bullets: Service providers acting on our behalf (payments, infrastructure, verification, analytics), subject to confidentiality obligations.
Competent authorities when required by law or to protect our rights.
Third parties in the context of a restructuring, merger, or sale, maintaining the protection of your data.

blocks.heading: Cookies and Similar Technologies
paragraphs: We use cookies and similar technologies for the operation of the Platform, to remember your preferences, and to analyze usage. You can configure your browser to reject cookies, although some features may not be available.

blocks.heading: Data Security
paragraphs: We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, loss, or alteration. However, no system is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

blocks.heading: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain your personal data for as long as necessary for the purposes described and to comply with our legal, accounting, and fraud-prevention obligations. After those periods, the data is deleted or anonymized.

blocks.heading: Your Rights
paragraphs: In accordance with applicable regulations, you may exercise the following rights over your data:
bullets: Access, rectification, and erasure of your data.
Restriction of or objection to processing.
Portability of the data you have provided to us.
Withdraw your consent at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of prior processing.

blocks.heading: International Transfers
paragraphs: Your data may be processed on servers located in different countries. In such cases, we adopt appropriate safeguards so that your information receives a level of protection equivalent to that required by applicable regulations.

blocks.heading: Minors
paragraphs: The Platform is not directed at persons under 18 years of age, and we do not knowingly collect data from minors. If we detect that data from a minor has been obtained, we will delete it as soon as possible.

blocks.heading: Changes to this Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will publish the current version on the Platform and indicate its update date. Continued use of the service implies acceptance of the revised Policy.

FAQ.title: We Have
FAQ.description: Do not hesitate to send us an email if you can't find what you're looking for.
FAQ.tab2: Can I watch the promotion live?
FAQ.tab3: How will I be notified if I win?
FAQ.tab1_q1: 📢 How is the promotion winner selected?
FAQ.tab1_a1: The winner will be selected in a 100% transparent manner, using the official results of the Costa Rica National Lottery. Once all promotion numbers are sold, an email will be sent to all participants with the official promotion date.
FAQ.tab1_q2: 🔹 How is the winning number determined?
FAQ.tab1_a2: The winning number is defined by referencing that day's results from the National Lottery: the first number corresponds to the ticket number and the second number corresponds to the series. Each participant is assigned a number and a series. For example, if your number is 11 and your series is 46, and on promotion day the first winning number is 11 and the second is 46 → the winner will be the full number: 1146.
FAQ.tab1_q3: ✅ Why does the process guarantee full transparency?
FAQ.tab1_a3: The result is based on an official, public and verifiable event — the Costa Rica National Lottery results — ensuring complete trust for all participants.
FAQ.tab2_q1: 📺 Can I watch the promotion live?
FAQ.tab2_a1: Yes, absolutely ✅ The Costa Rica National Lottery promotion is broadcast live and in real time. Anyone can verify the result as it happens, ensuring complete transparency.
FAQ.tab2_a2: 📺 National TV (Canal 13) · 🌐 Official website of the Junta de Protección Social · 📱 JPS official social media and YouTube channel.
FAQ.tab2_a3: Because the promotion is broadcast on an official, public and verifiable channel, every participant can confirm the result in real time — no intermediaries, no possibility of manipulation.
FAQ.tab3_q1: 📩 How will I be notified if I win?
FAQ.tab3_a1: If you are the winner, you will be contacted directly to confirm your prize 🎉 via the email address registered at the time of purchase and by phone call to confirm your details and arrange prize delivery.
FAQ.tab3_q2: 🔹 What contact methods will be used?
FAQ.tab3_a2: 📧 Registered email address · 📞 Phone call to confirm your information and coordinate prize delivery.
FAQ.tab3_q3: ✅ What should I check before participating?
FAQ.tab3_a3: Make sure your contact details (email and phone) are entered correctly when you register, as they will be the official means of reaching you if you win.
FAQ.q1: How and when are the winners selected?
FAQ.a1: The winners are selected randomly every week. The promotion takes place on Sunday at 10:00 AM.
FAQ.q2: Can I see the promotion live?
FAQ.a2: Yes, you can watch the promotion live on our website or through our social media channels.
FAQ.q3: How will I be notified if I win?
FAQ.a3: If you win any of the prizes, we will contact you through email or phone to confirm your win.
